body.message:
Hi, thanks for getting back to me so quickly, I appreciate it is a holiday in Dubai currently.  

I know Dubai very well having lived there for 13 years and like the city walk area a lot. I am returning in June, arriving early morning on the 2nd June.  I initially need an apartment for 1 month, will probably extend to 3 if all goes well.  I wanted to see if the apartment is available from the 2nd and if it would be possible to get access around 9am on the 2nd of June.
